name: FFS_ACTION_LINK
description: Contains standard and custom action links for the company.

columns.name: ACTION_LINK_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the action link.

columns.name: CUSTOM
columns.description: Boolean flag defining if this action link is created by user or provided as a part of SEED data.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique label identifying this action link.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Identifier of the entity this action can be performed for (activity, resource,. inventory, etc.)). If it is not specified, the action is available for several entities.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Defines the group of screens this action link can be added to (Dispatch. Technician screens supporting offline mode). If it is not specified. the restriction is not applied.

columns.name: BASE_LABEL
columns.description: Custom actions and plugins can inherit a behavior/conditions from an existent standard action. This field is intended to identify the standard action to inherit the behavior from.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: Set of boolean flags that define behavior of this action link.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of this action link: 'action', 'menu_item', 'dashboard_chart', 'quota_action', 'settings_item', 'mobile_action', 'web_routing', 'supervisor_menu_item', 'addon_action', 'resource_management_action', 'required_inventory_action', 'external_plugin_action',.

columns.name: SERVICE_LABEL
columns.description: Label of optional service this action link belongs to (Capacity, Routing, Forecasting, Smart_Location, ).

columns.name: MAX_VISIBILITY
columns.description: Maximum possible visibility level that can be specified when this link is added to a layout.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: URL for standard actions that are invoked from menu.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
